paragraphs: Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutrati: [Berakhot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.14); Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads R' Avin bar Zutrati.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Berakhot gives Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutrati reporting in Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevida’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1105&lang=en) gives a short notice of Rabbi Abbahu as Zutrati’s son. Avin bar Zutrati is the Dikdukei Soferim reading reported by Hyman.
